indicators.flag: Transaction details (email address, remittance information) make reference to species or animal parts of concern for illegal wildlife trade, particularly endangered species (e.g., ivory, tusk, scales, shark fin, tortoise, gecko).
indicators.red_flag: Transaction memo referencing wildlife species / animal-part keywords (ivory, scales, shark-fin)
indicators.rationale: Gap; requires D5 (Transaction narrative / free-text fields), not currently held → source data first.

indicators.flag: Media and/or law enforcement information links client or transacting parties to the illegal wildlife trade.
indicators.red_flag: Adverse-media / law-enforcement link of party to illegal wildlife trade
indicators.rationale: Partially covered by C19 (Adverse-media / OSINT & web-presence verification); data D13.

indicators.flag: Transaction details (contact name, email address, remittance information) specifies the role of the beneficiary of funds (e.g., poacher, coordinator, supplier, breeder, trader, courier).
indicators.red_flag: Memo naming a wildlife-trade-chain role (poacher, courier, breeder) for the payee
indicators.rationale: Gap; requires D5 (Transaction narrative / free-text fields), not currently held → source data first.

indicators.flag: An individual is the owner, operator, employee or associated with an industry that could be used to facilitate illegal wildlife trade (e.g., import/export of goods, fisheries wholesaler, pet store, freight company, animal control).
indicators.red_flag: Customer tied to a wildlife-facilitating industry (import/export, pet store, freight)
indicators.rationale: Gap; requires D8 (KYC / CDD & beneficial-ownership data), not currently held → source data first.

build_logic.logic: Flag a personal account whose inflow volume or wealth velocity is inconsistent with the customer's declared income, occupation, or stated source of funds, escalating when large credits lack a plausible origin for the customer's profile.
build_logic.window: rolling 90 days vs declared income profile
build_logic.source: personal deposit ledger joined to onboarding income/occupation KYC data
build_logic.route: Tier-1 alert â AML analyst review gate

indicators.flag: Individual or an entity has open source information10 linking them to the possession and/or advertising the sale of species of concern for illegal wildlife trade, particularly endangered species (e.g., geckos, turtles, and tortoises).
indicators.red_flag: OSINT linking party to possession / online sale of endangered species
indicators.rationale: Partially covered by C19 (Adverse-media / OSINT & web-presence verification); data D13.

indicators.flag: Individual received numerous transfers with wildlife-trade references from several parties, followed by outgoing transfers to an individual(s) who has also received similar email money transfers from other parties. The individual had very few or no other transactions in their account.
indicators.red_flag: Multi-originator funnel-in then forward-out to nominee (wildlife-fund collector pass-through)
indicators.rationale: Already covered by C3 (Multi-originator funnel-in / fan-out network detection).

indicators.flag: Individual or entity provides misleading or falsified documentation concerning wildlife trade (e.g., incorrect permits).
indicators.red_flag: Falsified / incorrect wildlife permits and trade documentation
indicators.rationale: Partially covered by C22 (Trade-based money-laundering & documentary anomaly detection); data D15.

indicators.flag: Frequent transfers to individuals and/or entities located in jurisdictions of concern for wildlife crime (e.g., China, Hong Kong, Australia, and Sub-Saharan Africa).
indicators.red_flag: Frequent transfers to wildlife-crime high-risk corridor (China, HK, Sub-Saharan Africa)
indicators.rationale: Already covered by C20 (Cross-border / high-risk-jurisdiction & corridor anomaly detection).

indicators.flag: Payments to entities operating in the traditional medicine market.
indicators.rationale: Gap; requires D4 (Card & merchant-category (MCC) transaction data), not currently held → source data first.

build_logic.logic: Flag a card or account whose merchant-category spend distribution shifts toward high-risk or atypical MCCs for the customer's segment, escalating when spend concentrates in cash-equivalent categories such as gift cards, prepaid, or money-services merchants.
build_logic.window: rolling 60 days vs segment MCC baseline
build_logic.source: card authorization/settlement feed enriched with MCC reference
build_logic.route: Tier-1 alert â AML analyst review gate

indicators.flag: Transaction details (email address, remittance information) make reference to traditional medicine or the traditional medicine market.
indicators.rationale: Gap; requires D5 (Transaction narrative / free-text fields), not currently held → source data first.

indicators.flag: Payments made to individuals and/or entities involved in an animal-related business (e.g., aquarium, zoo, veterinary clinic) that are inconsistent with the client’s profile.
indicators.red_flag: Out-of-profile payments to animal-related business (aquarium, zoo, vet)
indicators.rationale: Partially covered by C1 (Customer-profile / out-of-pattern transaction monitoring); data D1.

indicators.flag: Purchases and/or payments for travel-related purchases (e.g., airfare, lodging) to and from jurisdictions of concern for wildlife crime.
indicators.red_flag: Travel spend to/from wildlife-crime high-risk jurisdictions
indicators.rationale: Already covered by C20 (Cross-border / high-risk-jurisdiction & corridor anomaly detection).

indicators.flag: Individual or entity received multiple email money transfers or wire transfers referencing species or animal parts of concern for illegal wildlife trade from Canada (e.g., bear, grease, eels).
indicators.red_flag: Inbound EMT/wire memos referencing Canadian-export wildlife parts (bear, eels)
indicators.rationale: Gap; requires D3 (Wire / ACH / EFT & cross-border payment data (incl. EMT, P2P, remittance)), not currently held → source data first.

build_logic.logic: Flag a payment whose memo, reference, or narrative field matches high-risk keyword or coded-language patterns, escalating when flagged terms recur across a customer's payments or conflict with the stated counterparty relationship.
build_logic.source: wire/EMT/payment message free-text fields + curated keyword taxonomy
build_logic.route: Tier-1 alert â AML analyst review gate

indicators.flag: Frequent purchases and/or payments for animal related goods and services (e.g., animal supplies, cages, freight equipment).
indicators.red_flag: Recurring spend on animal-supply / cage / freight goods
indicators.rationale: Gap; requires D4 (Card & merchant-category (MCC) transaction data), not currently held → source data first.

build_logic.logic: Flag a card or account whose merchant-category spend distribution shifts toward high-risk or atypical MCCs for the customer's segment, escalating when spend concentrates in cash-equivalent categories such as gift cards, prepaid, or money-services merchants.
build_logic.window: rolling 60 days vs segment MCC baseline
build_logic.source: card authorization/settlement feed enriched with MCC reference
build_logic.route: Tier-1 alert â AML analyst review gate

indicators.flag: Frequent payments to shipping entities, postal services, and/or cargo services.
indicators.red_flag: Frequent shipping / postal / cargo-service payments (parcel-movement channel)
indicators.rationale: Gap; requires D15 (Trade-finance / customs / shipping & logistics data), not currently held → source data first.

indicators.flag: Payments received from individuals and/or entities involved in an animal-related business (e.g., aquarium, zoo, pet store) that are inconsistent with the client’s profile.
indicators.red_flag: Out-of-profile inbound payments from animal-related business (aquarium, zoo, pet store)
indicators.rationale: Partially covered by C1 (Customer-profile / out-of-pattern transaction monitoring); data D1.
